test_title: PYST 6: SSC CPO - English Held On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase.

He's still __keeping his chin up__ despite all his health problems.

options.text: To keep one’s chin clean and moist
To stay cheerful during difficult times
To save others during difficult times

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"keep one's chin up"** means to remain cheerful and hopeful despite facing difficulties or challenges. (मुश्किल समय में खुश रहना) • **Example: **Even though he lost his job, he is **keeping his chin up** and looking for new opportunities. • **"To stay cheerful during difficult times"** refers to maintaining a positive attitude even when things are tough. (मुश्किल समय में खुश रहना) • **Example: **She managed **to stay cheerful during her illness,** which inspired everyone around her. Therefore, the correct answer is: ***To stay cheerful during difficult times.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To keep one’s chin clean and moist** (अपनी ठोड़ी को साफ और नम रखना): This option is incorrect as it refers to physical cleanliness rather than an emotional state. • **Example:** It's important to keep your face clean and moist to maintain healthy skin. • **Option 2: To stay safe during difficulty** (मुश्किल समय में सुरक्षित रहना): This option is incorrect because it refers to safety rather than maintaining a positive attitude. • **Example: **During the storm, they stayed safe by taking shelter in the basement. • **Option 4: To save others during difficult times** (मुश्किल समय में दूसरों को बचाना): This option is incorrect as it refers to helping others rather than maintaining one's own morale. • **Example: **He always tries to save others during difficult situations, showing his bravery and kindness. 48:Taff, The correct answer is: **Option 1)**
